question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Nvidia)

calls.reasoning: Nvidia guided Q3 FY27 revenue to $108B ±2% (Aug 2026), excluding China data-centre compute. Over the last 8 quarters actual revenue came in at 1.025-1.08x guidance, median ~1.05 (Q2 FY27: $96.2B vs ~$91B guide). Applying the median gives ~$113.4B, shaded slightly to $113.2B for the October AI-financing and macro jitters, which mostly hit later quarters rather than one nearly booked. Analyst consensus is ~$111.3B (MarketBeat, Oct). Above $116B needs a >7.4% beat, seen in 1 of the last 8 quarters, so ~11%. A miss below $105B would mean missing the low end of guidance, which hasn't happened in the recent record. Market check: the only market found is a thin Manifold one (4 holders, ~M150) on the same GAAP revenue metric: <110 8%, 110-112 40%, 112-114 26%, 114-116 17%, >=116 10%. No Polymarket, Kalshi or bookmaker market found.
calls.dossier:
- Nvidia Q2 FY27 (reported late Aug 2026): revenue $96.2B (+106% y/y), Data Center $89.0B; consensus had been ~$92.2B; prior guide ~$91B (Nvidia release, stocktitan, Manifold note).
- Q3 FY27 guidance: $108B ±2% ($105.8B-$110.2B), gross margin 74.0% ±50bp, assumes no China Data Center compute revenue (Nvidia release, Webull/TIKR, Aug 2026).
- Pre-guide consensus for Q3 was ~$103.5-104.2B; October 2026 consensus ~$111.3B (MarketBeat, Oct 2026).
- Actual/guide ratios from memory, unverified this run: Q3FY25 35.1/32.5=1.08; Q4FY25 39.3/37.5=1.05; Q1FY26 44.1/43=1.025 (H20 charge); Q2FY26 46.7/45=1.04; Q3FY26 57.0/54=1.056; Q4FY26 68.1/65=1.048; Q1FY27 81.6/78=1.046; Q2FY27 96.2/~91=1.057. Ratio range 1.025-1.08, SD ~1.6pp. Over all 8 quarters, 0 missed the guide midpoint; 1 of 8 beat by >7.4% (the threshold for >$116B).
- Motley Fool (Sep 15 2026) argues the $108B guide is conservative; Vera Rubin ramp under way (TIKR).
- Oct 15 2026: NVDA down ~8% over 5 sessions, semis ETF -11%; hot Sept PPI (+1.3% m/m); TSMC cautious on 2027 but says demand still exceeds capacity and expects 2026 revenue +44%; Anthropic Q3 revenue $16.8B, +50% q/q (Invezz). Bearing on later guidance rather than the Aug-Oct quarter.
- Resolves off total revenue in Nvidia's Q3 FY27 earnings release (quarter ends ~late Oct 2026); release listed for Nov 25 in the question, Nov 18 per Manifold.
- Event window: quarter Aug-Oct 2026, release in Nov 2026; as of Oct 16 the quarter is ~85% elapsed and nothing reported.
- Searched, not found: any mid-quarter guidance update or pre-announcement; Kalshi/Polymarket contracts on this figure.

Over 8 quarters, actual revenue beat the guide midpoint by 2.5% to 7.9% (Q3FY25 +7.9%, Q4FY25 +4.9%, Q1FY26 +2.5% with the H20 China hit, Q2FY26 +3.9%, Q3FY26 +5.6%, Q4FY26 +4.8%, Q1FY27 +4.6%, Q2FY27 +5.7%). The median beat of ~4.9% implies about $113.3B. I shade slightly lower for macro and financing headwinds (the hot September PPI, the AI stock selloff), but those hit stock prices more than revenue already shipped in the quarter. Upside escape above $116B needs a beat over 7.4%, which happened once in 8 quarters. A miss below $105B has essentially no precedent outside a major export shock. Its contract measures the same quantity but is thin, so I treat it as weak evidence. I found no Polymarket or Kalshi market.

- Consensus Q3 FY27 EPS is ~$2.47; I did not find a revenue consensus figure.
- Status quo: revenue lands at guide midpoint plus the typical beat.
- Resolves off the revenue in Nvidia's Q3 FY27 earnings release (8-K), expected ~Nov 18-25 2026, not off later restatements.
- Event window: the fiscal quarter, roughly Jul 27 -> ~Oct 25 2026; as of 2026-10-16 about 90% of the quarter has elapsed. The reported number is set by quarter-end shipments.

calls.reconciliation: Runs agreed on all core facts (Q2 FY27 $96.2B vs $91B guide; Q3 guide $108B +/-2%; beat history 2.5-7.9%). Factual disputes: report date (Nov 17/18 vs 25) is immaterial to the value; analyst consensus ($108.7B/$108.9B/$111.3B) could not be settled without web access and is not load-bearing given the guide+beat model. Judgment disputes: upside-escape mass (7-11%) - I weight the recent six-quarter regime with no >7.4% beat and land at 7%; downside mass 0-2% - set 1.5% for export-shock tail. Median ~$113.1B follows the recent median beat, cross-checked by the q/q increment trend. No independent retrieval this run.
